newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Moscow City Telephone quotes split 100:1.
newsitem.headline: Moscow City Telephone quotes split 100:1.

text.p: Price quotations for shares of Moscow City Telephone on the Russian Trading System (RTS) have been divided by 100 effective Friday in a technical move, the NAUFOR brokers association said.
The move is an internal one by the RTS for presentational purposes. OAO Moskovskaya Gorodskaya Telefonnaya Set (MGTS) itself has not split its shares, NAUFOR said.
Trade lot sizes have also been divided by 100, to accurately reflect turnover, a spokesman for NAUFOR said.
MGTS had risen to $9.50 at 1300 GMT on Friday after closing at $924.00 on Thursday.
